describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of bare ground. It has the overall size, proportions, dense shaggy brown fur, and body shape of a brown bear, with a bear-like head, four thick legs and broad paws, but its entire back from the shoulders to the rump is covered by a large, glossy, dark brown, dome-shaped beetle-like shell with longitudinal ridges and a row of small oval openings along its lower edge, and a single large, glossy black, sickle-shaped horn curves upward and backward from the center of its forehead.

describe.description: The creature is a large four-legged mammal with the overall size, shape, thick shaggy brown fur, head, legs, clawed paws and short tail of a brown bear, shown standing in right-side profile. A large, domed, glossy dark-brown beetle-like carapace covers its entire back from behind the shoulders to the rump, and a single long, curved, glossy black horn like that of a rhinoceros beetle rises from the center of its forehead.
